articles.title: Lucid Gravity SUV Recognized as the 2026 World Luxury Car of the Year
articles.mainIdea: Lucid Gravity SUV Recognized as the 2026 World Luxury Car of the Year
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Lucid Gravity SUV Recognized as the 2026 World Luxury Car of the Year. Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID), maker of the world's most advanced software-defined vehicles and technologies, today announced that the Lucid Gravity has been named 2026 World Luxury Car of the Year by the esteemed World Car Awards program. In an awards category open to electric, hybrid, and internal-combustion vehicles, Lucid's all-electric SUV was recognized by a global jury of more than 100 acclaimed automotive journalists from around the globe.
